svg.text: Network Cost-Observability Pipeline — AI-Driven Analysis + Anomaly Detection
Based on 3 AWS reference blogs · Extended with QuickSight + Bedrock + 2 SNS Topics · Deployed via CloudFormation IaC
PATH A — Real-time pipeline + cost anomaly detection (< 60s latency)
① gzip decode + parse flow records
② filter: pilot VPC CIDR only
Private IP → ENI → service name tag
PATH B — Weekly AI optimization report (EventBridge every Monday → Bedrock Claude 3.5 Sonnet)
Lambda → Athena → S3 (shared with Path A)
Athena — Cost Queries ($5/TB, no fixed cost)
• Total cost by VPC · week-over-week trend
• Cross-AZ vs intra-AZ breakdown by port
Input: Athena JSON + cost context prompt
• Which services have mismatched AZ placement
• Specific fix per service (pin to AZ-a)
Requires model access activation in console
Lambda calls Athena → waits for results
TOP_N offenders configurable via env var
Pilot validated → published to all teams
📖 Blog #1 — Stream VPC Flow Logs via Kinesis Firehose: CloudWatch → Firehose → Lambda ETL → S3 → Athena → QuickSight
📖 Blog #2 — Cross-AZ cost calculation: Lambda computes cost_usd = bytes × $0.01/GB when src_az ≠ dst_az field in flow record
📖 Blog #3 — Enrich flow logs: Lambda calls EC2 describe_network_interfaces() to resolve private IPs → ENI → service name tag
★ Extended beyond blogs: QuickSight anomaly detection · 2 SNS Topics · Bedrock Claude 3.5 analysis · EventBridge weekly trigger
✅ Pilot strategy: 1 team → measure AZ-pinning impact → publish as company standard → scale to all teams
IaC: CloudFormation stack — Flow Logs · Firehose · Lambda (ETL + weekly) · S3 · Glue · Athena · CW Alarms · SNS
